findings.detail: The 2029 iHeartCommunications corporate bond source row has an Interest Rate of 9.13%, but the extracted private credit row has blank interest_rate.
The 2030 iHeartCommunications corporate bond source row has an Interest Rate of 10.88%, but the extracted private credit row has blank interest_rate.

rationale: Class 2 within-row adjudication. The flagged holdings rows are private credit corporate bonds with blank extracted interest_rate values. In the raw schedule table 251, the header row labels the field as Interest Rate and the matching iHeartCommunications rows show 9.13% for maturity 5/1/2029 and 10.88% for maturity 5/1/2030. The source therefore decides the question: the missing extracted rates are real extraction gaps, not a false alarm.
